title: Leaf rectangle count bounded by two to the complexity
statement: Let $p$ be a deterministic two-party communication protocol with input types $X$ (Alice) and $Y$ (Bob), and let $A \subseteq X$ and $B \subseteq Y$. Then the number of distinct rectangles among the auxiliary leaf rectangles of $p$ relative to the constraint $A \times B$ is at most $2^{c}$, where $c$ is the communication complexity of $p$.
hypotheses_covered: p is a deterministic communication protocol over X (Alice), Y (Bob), producing values in α
A is a subset of X
B is a subset of Y
replaced:
For any protocol $p$ and constraint sets $A, B$, the number of elements in
$\texttt{leafRectanglesAux}(p, A, B)$ is at most $2^{p.\texttt{complexity}}$.
